sources.title: Qwen 3.6-27B Complete Guide: 77.2% SWE-bench in a 27B Dense Model (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6-27B is a 27 billion parameter dense language model from Alibaba's Qwen team. It uses a hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention architecture, supports 256K context (extensible to 1M), handles text, image, and video inputs, and scores 77.2% on SWE-bench Verified.
